headline: What does my energy say about my soulmate?
note:
FRAME: soulmate x keyword. NO PARTICULAR MAN EXISTS — the read must not fall through to decode-him.

🔴 The ad already tells her she is the problem, which is the best fit on the funnel for this method: the card acquits her, and the block is what is left.

⚠ SHE is the subject of beats 3-6. The return-mhf figures are all male, so he is DESCRIBED in beats 1-2 and retired there — never given intent or motion toward her, or a soulmate lander turns into reunion copy.

⚠ NO FAMILY-LINE LANGUAGE anywhere in the read.

⚠ The softest ad in the family — it does not assert a block, it asks for a reading. So beat 3 answers the question straight (what her energy says) and beat 5 still earns the block off beat 4.

a: You turned the Magician. Nothing showed through, and you took the one with nothing put away.
Look at his table. It's out in the open, and all of it is in reach.
You asked what your energy says about your soulmate. The thing I keep looking at is how much of this card is ready to hand.
And yet nobody has come. And it's your own side of it you're asking about.
Something stands in the space between, close in. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what it is…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The backs gave nothing away, and yours was the card still growing.
Look at the wood he hangs from. Green leaves, on living wood.
You asked what your energy says about your soulmate. This card makes me look at something alive with a rope on it.
Still, nobody has come. And the reading you want is of your own side.
Something comes in just as things would move. I don't think any of it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's holding this…
c: You turned the Fool. You couldn't see the faces, and you chose the one already on his way.
Look at his feet. One is lifted, the other still down.
You asked what your energy says about your soulmate. The movement here has already started.
But nobody has come. And you're the one asking what your part of it says.
The hold here is light, and it doesn't loosen. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's holding this…
